title: VPN error 619 on Windows laptop
text: Screenshot showed Error 619: A connection to the remote computer could not be established. Pushing the VPN profile fixed it.

title: Locked out of VPN after failed sign-ins
text: User was locked out of VPN before a client call after several failed sign-ins. Unlocking the account fixed it.

title: Lost phone, authenticator not working
text: User got a new phone and the authenticator app stopped working. MFA reset after identity check.

title: Forgot password
text: User forgot their password and could not sign in. Password reset after identity check.

title: VPN error 619 reinstall attempt
text: Error 619 remote computer connection failure. Reinstalling the VPN client did not fix it.
